items.prompt: Why is inv[M%i] already available in an ascending loop?

options.text: M%i equals i-1 for every i
options.why: The remainder is smaller than i, but need not be exactly its predecessor.

options.text: Every nonzero inverse is initialized before the loop
options.why: Only inv[1] is initialized; each later entry is derived from a smaller computed dependency.

options.text: The next iteration will compute inv[M%i] before this expression needs it
options.why: This expression needs its dependency now, not in a future iteration.
Prime M and 1<i<M rule out zero remainder.

items.explanation: A valid nonzero smaller dependency proves the order.
